segments.mn66:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā aṅguttarāpesu viharati āpaṇaṃ nāma aṅguttarāpānaṃ nigamo.
segments.mn66:2.1: Atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya āpaṇaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
segments.mn66:2.2: Āpaṇe piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yenaññataro vanasaṇḍo tenupasaṅkami divāvihārāya.
segments.mn66:2.3: Taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ ajjhogāhetvā aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle divāvihāraṃ nisīdi.
segments.mn66:3.1: Āyasmāpi kho udāyī pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya āpaṇaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
segments.mn66:3.2: Āpaṇe piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena so vanasaṇḍo tenupasaṅkami divāvihārāya.
segments.mn66:3.3: Taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ ajjhogāhetvā aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle divāvihāraṃ nisīdi.
segments.mn66:3.4: Atha kho āyasmato udāyissa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi –
segments.mn66:4.1: “bahūnaṃ [bahunnaṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.) evamīdise aviññāṇakappakaraṇe] vata no bhagavā dukkhadhammānaṃ apahattā, bahūnaṃ vata no bhagavā sukhadhammānaṃ upahattā;
segments.mn66:4.2: bahūnaṃ vata no bhagavā akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ apahattā, bahūnaṃ vata no bhagavā kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upahattā”ti.
segments.mn66:5.1: Atha kho āyasmā udāyī sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā udāyī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn66:6.1: “idha mayhaṃ, bhante, rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi –
segments.mn66:6.2: ‘bahūnaṃ vata no bhagavā dukkhadhammānaṃ apahattā, bahūnaṃ vata no bhagavā sukhadhammānaṃ upahattā;
segments.mn66:6.3: bahūnaṃ vata no bhagavā akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ apahattā, bahūnaṃ vata no bhagavā kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upahattā’ti.
segments.mn66:6.4: Mayañhi, bhante, pubbe sāyañceva bhuñjāma pāto ca divā ca vikāle.
segments.mn66:6.5: Ahu kho so, bhante, samayo yaṃ bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi –
segments.mn66:6.7: Tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, ahudeva aññathattaṃ, ahudeva [ahu (sī. pī.)] domanassaṃ –
segments.mn66:6.8: ‘yampi no saddhā gahapatikā divā vikāle paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ denti tassapi no bhagavā pahānamāha, tassapi no sugato paṭinissaggamāhā’ti.
segments.mn66:6.9: Te mayaṃ, bhante, bhagavati pemañca gāravañca hiriñca ottappañca sampassamānā evaṃ taṃ divāvikālabhojanaṃ pajahimhā.
segments.mn66:6.10: Te mayaṃ, bhante, sāyañceva bhuñjāma pāto ca.
segments.mn66:6.11: Ahu kho so, bhante, samayo yaṃ bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi –
segments.mn66:6.13: Tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, ahudeva aññathattaṃ ahudeva domanassaṃ –
segments.mn66:6.14: ‘yampi no imesaṃ dvinnaṃ bhattānaṃ paṇītasaṅkhātataraṃ tassapi no bhagavā pahānamāha, tassapi no sugato paṭinissaggamāhā’ti.
segments.mn66:6.15: Bhūtapubbaṃ, bhante, aññataro puriso divā sūpeyyaṃ labhitvā evamāha –
segments.mn66:6.16: ‘handa ca imaṃ nikkhipatha, sāyaṃ sabbeva samaggā bhuñjissāmā’ti.
segments.mn66:6.17: Yā kāci, bhante, saṅkhatiyo sabbā tā rattiṃ, appā divā.
segments.mn66:6.18: Te mayaṃ, bhante, bhagavati pemañca gāravañca hiriñca ottappañca sampassamānā evaṃ taṃ rattiṃvikālabhojanaṃ pajahimhā.
segments.mn66:6.19: Bhūtapubbaṃ, bhante, bhikkhū rattandhakāratimisāyaṃ piṇḍāya carantā candanikampi pavisanti, oligallepi papatanti, kaṇṭakāvāṭampi [kaṇṭakavattampi (sī. pī.), kaṇṭakarājimpi (syā. kaṃ.)] ārohanti, suttampi gāviṃ ārohanti, māṇavehipi samāgacchanti katakammehipi akatakammehipi, mātugāmopi te [tena (ka.)] asaddhammena nimanteti.
segments.mn66:6.21: Addasā kho maṃ, bhante, aññatarā itthī vijjantarikāya bhājanaṃ dhovantī.
segments.mn66:6.24: Evaṃ vutte, ahaṃ, bhante, taṃ itthiṃ etadavocaṃ –
segments.mn66:6.28: Varaṃ te, bhikkhu, tiṇhena govikantanena kucchi parikanto, na tveva varaṃ yaṃ [na tveva yā (sī. pī.)] rattandhakāratimisāyaṃ kucchihetu piṇḍāya carasī’ti [carasāti (sī. pī.)].
segments.mn66:6.29: Tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, tadanussarato evaṃ hoti –
segments.mn66:6.30: ‘bahūnaṃ vata no bhagavā dukkhadhammānaṃ apahattā, bahūnaṃ vata no bhagavā sukhadhammānaṃ upahattā;
segments.mn66:6.31: bahūnaṃ vata no bhagavā akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ apahattā, bahūnaṃ vata no bhagavā kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upahattā’”ti.
segments.mn66:7.1: “Evameva panudāyi, idhekacce moghapurisā ‘idaṃ pajahathā’ti mayā vuccamānā te evamāhaṃsu –
segments.mn66:7.3: Te tañceva nappajahanti, mayi ca appaccayaṃ upaṭṭhāpenti.
segments.mn66:7.4: Ye ca bhikkhū sikkhākāmā tesaṃ taṃ, udāyi, hoti balavaṃ bandhanaṃ, daḷhaṃ bandhanaṃ, thiraṃ bandhanaṃ, apūtikaṃ bandhanaṃ, thūlo, kaliṅgaro – seyyathāpi, udāyi, laṭukikā sakuṇikā pūtilatāya bandhanena baddhā tattheva vadhaṃ vā bandhaṃ vā maraṇaṃ vā āgameti.
segments.mn66:8.2: Yo nu kho, udāyi, evaṃ vadeyya –
segments.mn66:8.3: ‘yena sā laṭukikā sakuṇikā pūtilatāya bandhanena baddhā tattheva vadhaṃ vā bandhaṃ vā maraṇaṃ vā āgameti, tañhi tassā abalaṃ bandhanaṃ, dubbalaṃ bandhanaṃ, pūtikaṃ bandhanaṃ, asārakaṃ bandhanan’ti;
segments.mn66:8.4: sammā nu kho so, udāyi, vadamāno vadeyyā”ti?
segments.mn66:8.6: Yena sā, bhante, laṭukikā sakuṇikā pūtilatāya bandhanena baddhā tattheva vadhaṃ vā bandhaṃ vā maraṇaṃ vā āgameti, tañhi tassā balavaṃ bandhanaṃ, daḷhaṃ bandhanaṃ, thiraṃ bandhanaṃ apūtikaṃ bandhanaṃ, thūlo, kaliṅgaro”ti.
segments.mn66:8.7: “Evameva kho, udāyi, idhekacce moghapurisā ‘idaṃ pajahathā’ti mayā vuccamānā te evamāhaṃsu –
segments.mn66:8.9: Te tañceva nappajahanti, mayi ca appaccayaṃ upaṭṭhāpenti.
segments.mn66:8.10: Ye ca bhikkhū sikkhākāmā tesaṃ taṃ, udāyi, hoti balavaṃ bandhanaṃ, daḷhaṃ bandhanaṃ, thiraṃ bandhanaṃ, apūtikaṃ bandhanaṃ, thūlo, kaliṅgaro”.
segments.mn66:9.1: “Idha panudāyi, ekacce kulaputtā ‘idaṃ pajahathā’ti mayā vuccamānā te evamāhaṃsu –
segments.mn66:9.2: ‘kiṃ panimassa appamattakassa oramattakassa pahātabbassa yassa no bhagavā pahānamāha, yassa no sugato paṭinissaggamāhā’ti?
segments.mn66:9.3: Te tañceva pajahanti, mayi ca na appaccayaṃ upaṭṭhāpenti.
segments.mn66:9.4: Ye ca bhikkhū sikkhākāmā te taṃ pahāya appossukkā pannalomā paradattavuttā [paradavuttā (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] migabhūtena cetasā viharanti.
segments.mn66:9.5: Tesaṃ taṃ, udāyi, hoti abalaṃ bandhanaṃ, dubbalaṃ bandhanaṃ, pūtikaṃ bandhanaṃ, asārakaṃ bandhanaṃ – seyyathāpi, udāyi, rañño nāgo īsādanto urūḷhavā abhijāto saṅgāmāvacaro daḷhehi varattehi bandhanehi baddho īsakaṃyeva kāyaṃ sannāmetvā tāni bandhanāni saṃchinditvā saṃpadāletvā yena kāmaṃ pakkamati.
segments.mn66:10.2: Yo nu kho, udāyi, evaṃ vadeyya –
segments.mn66:10.3: ‘yehi so rañño nāgo īsādanto urūḷhavā abhijāto saṅgāmāvacaro daḷhehi varattehi bandhanehi baddho īsakaṃyeva kāyaṃ sannāmetvā tāni bandhanāni saṃchinditvā saṃpadāletvā yena kāmaṃ pakkamati, tañhi tassa balavaṃ bandhanaṃ, daḷhaṃ bandhanaṃ, thiraṃ bandhanaṃ, apūtikaṃ bandhanaṃ, thūlo, kaliṅgaro’ti;
segments.mn66:10.4: sammā nu kho so, udāyi, vadamāno vadeyyā”ti?
segments.mn66:10.6: Yehi so, bhante, rañño nāgo īsādanto urūḷhavā abhijāto saṅgāmāvacaro daḷhehi varattehi bandhanehi baddho īsakaṃyeva kāyaṃ sannāmetvā tāni bandhanāni saṃchinditvā saṃpadāletvā yena kāmaṃ pakkamati, tañhi tassa abalaṃ bandhanaṃ … pe … asārakaṃ bandhanan”ti.
segments.mn66:10.7: “Evameva kho, udāyi, idhekacce kulaputtā ‘idaṃ pajahathā’ti mayā vuccamānā te evamāhaṃsu –
segments.mn66:10.8: ‘kiṃ panimassa appamattakassa oramattakassa pahātabbassa yassa no bhagavā pahānamāha, yassa no sugato paṭinissaggamāhā’ti?
segments.mn66:10.9: Te tañceva pajahanti, mayi ca na appaccayaṃ upaṭṭhāpenti.
segments.mn66:10.10: Ye ca bhikkhū sikkhākāmā te taṃ pahāya appossukkā pannalomā paradattavuttā migabhūtena cetasā viharanti.
segments.mn66:10.11: Tesaṃ taṃ, udāyi, hoti abalaṃ bandhanaṃ, dubbalaṃ bandhanaṃ, pūtikaṃ bandhanaṃ, asārakaṃ bandhanaṃ”.
segments.mn66:11.2: tassa’ ssa ekaṃ agārakaṃ oluggaviluggaṃ kākātidāyiṃ [kākātiḍāyiṃ (?)] naparamarūpaṃ, ekā khaṭopikā [kaḷopikā (ka.)] oluggaviluggā naparamarūpā, ekissā kumbhiyā dhaññasamavāpakaṃ naparamarūpaṃ, ekā jāyikā naparamarūpā.
segments.mn66:11.3: So ārāmagataṃ bhikkhuṃ passeyya sudhotahatthapādaṃ manuññaṃ bhojanaṃ bhuttāviṃ sītāya chāyāya nisinnaṃ adhicitte yuttaṃ.
segments.mn66:11.5: ‘sukhaṃ vata, bho, sāmaññaṃ, ārogyaṃ vata, bho, sāmaññaṃ!
segments.mn66:11.6: So vatassaṃ [so vatassa (ka.)] yohaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyyan’ti.
segments.mn66:11.7: So na sakkuṇeyya ekaṃ agārakaṃ oluggaviluggaṃ kākātidāyiṃ naparamarūpaṃ pahāya, ekaṃ khaṭopikaṃ oluggaviluggaṃ naparamarūpaṃ pahāya, ekissā kumbhiyā dhaññasamavāpakaṃ naparamarūpaṃ pahāya, ekaṃ jāyikaṃ naparamarūpaṃ pahāya kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajituṃ.
segments.mn66:11.8: Yo nu kho, udāyi, evaṃ vadeyya –
segments.mn66:11.9: ‘yehi so puriso bandhanehi baddho na sakkoti ekaṃ agārakaṃ oluggaviluggaṃ kākātidāyiṃ naparamarūpaṃ pahāya, ekaṃ khaṭopikaṃ oluggaviluggaṃ naparamarūpaṃ pahāya, ekissā kumbhiyā dhaññasamavāpakaṃ naparamarūpaṃ pahāya, ekaṃ jāyikaṃ naparamarūpaṃ pahāya kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajituṃ;
segments.mn66:11.10: tañhi tassa abalaṃ bandhanaṃ, dubbalaṃ bandhanaṃ, pūtikaṃ bandhanaṃ, asārakaṃ bandhanan’ti;
segments.mn66:11.11: sammā nu kho so, udāyi, vadamāno vadeyyā”ti?
segments.mn66:11.13: Yehi so, bhante, puriso bandhanehi baddho, na sakkoti ekaṃ agārakaṃ oluggaviluggaṃ kākātidāyiṃ naparamarūpaṃ pahāya, ekaṃ khaṭopikaṃ oluggaviluggaṃ naparamarūpaṃ pahāya, ekissā kumbhiyā dhaññasamavāpakaṃ naparamarūpaṃ pahāya, ekaṃ jāyikaṃ naparamarūpaṃ pahāya kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajituṃ;
segments.mn66:11.14: tañhi tassa balavaṃ bandhanaṃ, daḷhaṃ bandhanaṃ, thiraṃ bandhanaṃ, apūtikaṃ bandhanaṃ, thūlo, kaliṅgaro”ti.
segments.mn66:11.15: “Evameva kho, udāyi, idhekacce moghapurisā ‘idaṃ pajahathā’ti mayā vuccamānā te evamāhaṃsu –
segments.mn66:11.17: Te tañceva nappajahanti, mayi ca appaccayaṃ upaṭṭhāpenti.
segments.mn66:11.18: Ye ca bhikkhū sikkhākāmā tesaṃ taṃ, udāyi, hoti balavaṃ bandhanaṃ, daḷhaṃ bandhanaṃ, thiraṃ bandhanaṃ, apūtikaṃ bandhanaṃ, thūlo, kaliṅgaro”.
segments.mn66:12.1: “Seyyathāpi, udāyi, gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā aḍḍho mahaddhano mahābhogo, nekānaṃ nikkhagaṇānaṃ cayo, nekānaṃ dhaññagaṇānaṃ cayo, nekānaṃ khettagaṇānaṃ cayo, nekānaṃ vatthugaṇānaṃ cayo, nekānaṃ bhariyagaṇānaṃ cayo, nekānaṃ dāsagaṇānaṃ cayo, nekānaṃ dāsigaṇānaṃ cayo;
segments.mn66:12.2: so ārāmagataṃ bhikkhuṃ passeyya sudhotahatthapādaṃ manuññaṃ bhojanaṃ bhuttāviṃ sītāya chāyāya nisinnaṃ adhicitte yuttaṃ.
segments.mn66:12.4: ‘sukhaṃ vata, bho, sāmaññaṃ, ārogyaṃ vata, bho, sāmaññaṃ!
segments.mn66:12.5: So vatassaṃ yohaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyyan’ti.
segments.mn66:12.6: So sakkuṇeyya nekāni nikkhagaṇāni pahāya, nekāni dhaññagaṇāni pahāya, nekāni khettagaṇāni pahāya, nekāni vatthugaṇāni pahāya, nekāni bhariyagaṇāni pahāya, nekāni dāsagaṇāni pahāya, nekāni dāsigaṇāni pahāya kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajituṃ.
segments.mn66:12.7: Yo nu kho, udāyi, evaṃ vadeyya –
segments.mn66:12.8: ‘yehi so gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā bandhanehi baddho, sakkoti nekāni nikkhagaṇāni pahāya, nekāni dhaññagaṇāni pahāya, nekāni khettagaṇāni pahāya, nekāni vatthugaṇāni pahāya, nekāni bhariyagaṇāni pahāya, nekāni dāsagaṇāni pahāya, nekāni dāsigaṇāni pahāya kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajituṃ, tañhi tassa balavaṃ bandhanaṃ, daḷhaṃ bandhanaṃ, thiraṃ bandhanaṃ, apūtikaṃ bandhanaṃ, thūlo, kaliṅgaro’ti;
segments.mn66:12.9: sammā nu kho so, udāyi, vadamāno vadeyyā”ti?
segments.mn66:12.11: Yehi so, bhante, gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā bandhanehi baddho, sakkoti nekāni nikkhagaṇāni pahāya, nekāni dhaññagaṇāni pahāya, nekāni khettagaṇāni pahāya, nekāni vatthugaṇāni pahāya, nekāni bhariyagaṇāni pahāya, nekāni dāsagaṇāni pahāya, nekāni dāsigaṇāni pahāya kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajituṃ;
segments.mn66:12.12: tañhi tassa abalaṃ bandhanaṃ, dubbalaṃ bandhanaṃ, pūtikaṃ bandhanaṃ, asārakaṃ bandhanan”ti.
segments.mn66:12.13: “Evameva kho, udāyi, idhekacce kulaputtā ‘idaṃ pajahathā’ti mayā vuccamānā te evamāhaṃsu –
segments.mn66:12.14: ‘kiṃ panimassa appamattakassa oramattakassa pahātabbassa yassa no bhagavā pahānamāha yassa, no sugato paṭinissaggamāhā’ti?
segments.mn66:12.15: Te tañceva pajahanti, mayi ca na appaccayaṃ upaṭṭhāpenti.
segments.mn66:12.16: Ye ca bhikkhū sikkhākāmā te taṃ pahāya appossukkā pannalomā paradattavuttā migabhūtena cetasā viharanti.
segments.mn66:12.17: Tesaṃ taṃ, udāyi, hoti abalaṃ bandhanaṃ, dubbalaṃ bandhanaṃ, pūtikaṃ bandhanaṃ, asārakaṃ bandhanaṃ”.
segments.mn66:14.1: Idhudāyi, ekacco puggalo upadhipahānāya paṭipanno hoti upadhipaṭinissaggāya.
segments.mn66:14.2: Tamenaṃ upadhipahānāya paṭipannaṃ upadhipaṭinissaggāya upadhipaṭisaṃyuttā sarasaṅkappā samudācaranti.
segments.mn66:14.3: So te adhivāseti, nappajahati, na vinodeti, na byantīkaroti, na anabhāvaṃ gameti.
segments.mn66:14.4: Imaṃ kho ahaṃ, udāyi, puggalaṃ ‘saṃyutto’ti vadāmi no ‘visaṃyutto’.
segments.mn66:14.6: Indriyavemattatā hi me, udāyi, imasmiṃ puggale viditā.
segments.mn66:15.1: “Idha panudāyi, ekacco puggalo upadhipahānāya paṭipanno hoti upadhipaṭinissaggāya.
segments.mn66:15.2: Tamenaṃ upadhipahānāya paṭipannaṃ upadhipaṭinissaggāya upadhipaṭisaṃyuttā sarasaṅkappā samudācaranti.
segments.mn66:15.3: So te nādhivāseti, pajahati, vinodeti, byantīkaroti, anabhāvaṃ gameti.
segments.mn66:15.4: Imampi kho ahaṃ, udāyi, puggalaṃ ‘saṃyutto’ti vadāmi no ‘visaṃyutto’.
segments.mn66:15.6: Indriyavemattatā hi me, udāyi, imasmiṃ puggale viditā.
segments.mn66:16.1: “Idha panudāyi, ekacco puggalo upadhipahānāya paṭipanno hoti upadhipaṭinissaggāya.
segments.mn66:16.2: Tamenaṃ upadhipahānāya paṭipannaṃ upadhipaṭinissaggāya kadāci karahaci satisammosā upadhipaṭisaṃyuttā sarasaṅkappā samudācaranti;
segments.mn66:16.4: Atha kho naṃ khippameva pajahati, vinodeti, byantīkaroti, anabhāvaṃ gameti.
segments.mn66:16.5: Seyyathāpi, udāyi, puriso divasaṃsantatte [divasasantatte (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] ayokaṭāhe dve vā tīṇi vā udakaphusitāni nipāteyya;
segments.mn66:16.6: dandho, udāyi, udakaphusitānaṃ nipāto. Atha kho naṃ khippameva parikkhayaṃ pariyādānaṃ gaccheyya.
segments.mn66:16.7: Evameva kho, udāyi, idhekacco puggalo upadhipahānāya paṭipanno hoti upadhipaṭinissaggāya.
segments.mn66:16.8: Tamenaṃ upadhipahānāya paṭipannaṃ upadhipaṭinissaggāya kadāci karahaci satisammosā upadhipaṭisaṃyuttā sarasaṅkappā samudācaranti;
segments.mn66:16.10: Atha kho naṃ khippameva pajahati, vinodeti, byantīkaroti, anabhāvaṃ gameti.
segments.mn66:16.11: Imampi kho ahaṃ, udāyi, puggalaṃ ‘saṃyutto’ti vadāmi no ‘visaṃyutto’.
segments.mn66:16.13: Indriyavemattatā hi me, udāyi, imasmiṃ puggale viditā.
segments.mn66:17.1: “Idha panudāyi, ekacco puggalo ‘upadhi dukkhassa mūlan’ti – iti viditvā nirupadhi hoti, upadhisaṅkhaye vimutto.
segments.mn66:17.3: Imaṃ kho ahaṃ, udāyi, puggalaṃ ‘visaṃyutto’ti vadāmi no ‘saṃyutto’ti.
segments.mn66:17.5: Indriyavemattatā hi me, udāyi, imasmiṃ puggale viditā.
segments.mn66:17.6: Ime kho, udāyi, cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
segments.mn66:18.3: Cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā, sotaviññeyyā saddā … pe … ghānaviññeyyā gandhā … jivhāviññeyyā rasā … kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
segments.mn66:19.1: Yaṃ kho, udāyi, ime pañca kāmaguṇe paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ idaṃ vuccati kāmasukhaṃ miḷhasukhaṃ [mīḷhasukhaṃ (sī. pī.)] puthujjanasukhaṃ anariyasukhaṃ, na sevitabbaṃ, na bhāvetabbaṃ, na bahulīkātabbaṃ; ‘bhāyitabbaṃ etassa sukhassā’ti vadāmi.
segments.mn66:20.1: “Idhudāyi, bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi … pe … paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati, vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā … dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati, pītiyā ca virāgā … tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati, sukhassa ca pahānā … catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
segments.mn66:21.1: Idaṃ vuccati nekkhammasukhaṃ pavivekasukhaṃ upasamasukhaṃ sambodhasukhaṃ, āsevitabbaṃ, bhāvetabbaṃ, bahulīkātabbaṃ; ‘na bhāyitabbaṃ etassa sukhassā’ti vadāmi.
segments.mn66:22.1: “Idhudāyi, bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi … pe … paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati;
segments.mn66:22.2: idaṃ kho ahaṃ, udāyi, iñjitasmiṃ vadāmi.
segments.mn66:22.4: Yadeva tattha vitakkavicārā aniruddhā honti idaṃ tattha iñjitasmiṃ.
segments.mn66:23.1: Idhudāyi, bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā … pe … dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati;
segments.mn66:23.2: idampi kho ahaṃ, udāyi, iñjitasmiṃ vadāmi.
segments.mn66:23.4: Yadeva tattha pītisukhaṃ aniruddhaṃ hoti idaṃ tattha iñjitasmiṃ.
segments.mn66:24.1: Idhudāyi, bhikkhu pītiyā ca virāgā … pe … tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati;
segments.mn66:24.2: idampi kho ahaṃ, udāyi, iñjitasmiṃ vadāmi.
segments.mn66:24.4: Yadeva tattha upekkhāsukhaṃ aniruddhaṃ hoti idaṃ tattha iñjitasmiṃ.
segments.mn66:25.1: Idhudāyi, bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā … pe … catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati;
segments.mn66:25.2: idaṃ kho ahaṃ, udāyi, aniñjitasmiṃ vadāmi.
segments.mn66:26.1: “Idhudāyi, bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi … pe … paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati;
segments.mn66:26.2: idaṃ kho ahaṃ, udāyi,‘analan’ti vadāmi,‘pajahathā’ti vadāmi,‘samatikkamathā’ti vadāmi.
segments.mn66:27.1: Idhudāyi, bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā … dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati, ayaṃ tassa samatikkamo;
segments.mn66:27.2: idampi kho ahaṃ, udāyi,‘analan’ti vadāmi,‘pajahathā’ti vadāmi,‘samatikkamathā’ti vadāmi.
segments.mn66:28.1: Idhudāyi, bhikkhu pītiyā ca virāgā … tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati, ayaṃ tassa samatikkamo;
segments.mn66:28.2: idampi kho ahaṃ, udāyi,‘analan’ti vadāmi,‘pajahathā’ti vadāmi,‘samatikkamathā’ti vadāmi.
segments.mn66:29.1: Idhudāyi, bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā … catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati, ayaṃ tassa samatikkamo;
segments.mn66:29.2: idampi kho ahaṃ, udāyi,‘analan’ti vadāmi,‘pajahathā’ti vadāmi,‘samatikkamathā’ti vadāmi.
segments.mn66:30.1: Idhudāyi, bhikkhu sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ‘ananto ākāso’ti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati, ayaṃ tassa samatikkamo;
segments.mn66:30.2: idampi kho ahaṃ, udāyi,‘analan’ti vadāmi,‘pajahathā’ti vadāmi,‘samatikkamathā’ti vadāmi.
segments.mn66:31.1: Idhudāyi, bhikkhu sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘anantaṃ viññāṇan’ti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati, ayaṃ tassa samatikkamo;
segments.mn66:31.2: idampi kho ahaṃ, udāyi,‘analan’ti vadāmi,‘pajahathā’ti vadāmi,‘samatikkamathā’ti vadāmi.
segments.mn66:32.1: Idhudāyi, bhikkhu sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘natthi kiñcī’ti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati, ayaṃ tassa samatikkamo;
segments.mn66:32.2: idampi kho ahaṃ, udāyi,‘analan’ti vadāmi,‘pajahathā’ti vadāmi,‘samatikkamathā’ti vadāmi.
segments.mn66:33.1: Idhudāyi, bhikkhu sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati, ayaṃ tassa samatikkamo;
segments.mn66:33.2: idampi kho ahaṃ, udāyi,‘analan’ti vadāmi,‘pajahathā’ti vadāmi,‘samatikkamathā’ti vadāmi.
segments.mn66:34.1: Idhudāyi, bhikkhu sabbaso nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja viharati, ayaṃ tassa samatikkamo;
segments.mn66:34.2: iti kho ahaṃ, udāyi, nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassapi pahānaṃ vadāmi.
segments.mn66:34.3: Passasi no tvaṃ, udāyi, taṃ saṃyojanaṃ aṇuṃ vā thūlaṃ vā yassāhaṃ no pahānaṃ vadāmī”ti?
segments.mn66:34.6: Attamano āyasmā udāyī bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti.

lines: Tattha yena so vanasaṇḍoti ayampi mahāudāyitthero bhagavatā saddhiṃyeva piṇḍāya pavisitvā saddhiṃ paṭikkami.
Tasmā yena so bhagavatā upasaṅkamanto vanasaṇḍo tenupasaṅkamīti veditabbo.
Tañca kho na bhagavantaṃ paṭicca, evarūpaṃ pana paṇītabhojanaṃ alabhantā kathaṃ yāpessāmāti evaṃ paṇītabhojanaṃ paṭicca ahosīti veditabbaṃ.
Sabbā tā rattinti sabbā tā saṅkhatiyo rattiṃyeva honti, divā pana appā parittā thokikā hontīti.
Manussā hi divā yāgukañjiyādīhi yāpetvāpi rattiṃ yathāsatti yathāpaṇītameva bhuñjanti.
Puna bhūtapubbanti iminā ratti vikālabhojane ādīnavaṃ dasseti.
Corā kira katakammā yaṃ nesaṃ devataṃ āyācitvā kammaṃ nipphannaṃ, tassa upahāratthāya manusse māretvā galalohitādīni gaṇhanti.
Te aññesu manussesu māriyamānesu kolāhalā uppajjissanti, pabbajitaṃ pariyesanto nāma natthīti maññamānā bhikkhū gahetvā mārenti.
Akatakammehīti aṭavito gāmaṃ āgamanakāle kammanipphannatthaṃ puretaraṃ balikammaṃ kātukāmehi.
Asaddhammena nimantetīti “ehi bhikkhu ajjekarattiṃ idheva bhuñjitvā idha vasitvā sampattiṃ anubhavitvā sve gamissasī”ti methunadhammena nimanteti.
Abhummeti bhū’ti vaḍḍhi, abhū’ti avaḍḍhi, vināso mayhanti attho.
Pisāco vata manti pisāco maṃ khādituṃ āgato vata.
Idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti – yassa pitā vā mātā vā atthi, taṃ mātāpitaro amhākaṃ puttakoti yathā tathā vā uppādetvā yaṃkiñci khādanīyabhojanīyaṃ datvā ekasmiṃ ṭhāne sayāpenti.
So evaṃ rattiṃ piṇḍāya na carati.
Tuyhaṃ pana mātāpitaro matā maññe, tena evaṃ carasīti.
Kiṃ panimassāti imassa appamattakassa hetu kiṃ vattabbaṃ nāma, nanu apassantena viya asuṇantena viya bhavitabbanti.
Adhisallikhatevāyanti ayaṃ samaṇo navanītaṃ pisanto viya padumanāḷasuttaṃ kakacena okkantanto viya atisallekhati, ativāyāmaṃ karoti.
Sikkhākāmāti sāriputtamoggallānādayo viya sikkhākāmā, tesu ca appaccayaṃ upaṭṭhapenti.
Tesañhi evaṃ hoti “sace ete ‘appamattakametaṃ, haratha bhagavā’ti vadeyyuṃ, kiṃ satthā na hareyya.
Evaṃ pana avatvā bhagavantaṃ parivāretvā nisinnā ‘evaṃ bhagavā, sādhu bhagavā, paññapetha bhagavā’ti atirekataraṃ ussāhaṃ paṭilabhantī”ti.
Thūlo kaliṅgaroti gale baddhaṃ mahākaṭṭhaṃ viya hoti.
Sā kira ravasataṃ ravitvā naccasataṃ naccitvā sakiṃ gocaraṃ gaṇhāti.
Ākāsato bhūmiyaṃ patiṭṭhitaṃ pana naṃ disvā vacchapālakādayo kīḷanatthaṃ pūtilatāya bandhanti.
Tañhi tassāti taṃ pūtilatābandhanaṃ tassā appasarīratāya ceva appathāmatāya ca balavabandhanaṃ nāma, mahantaṃ nāḷikerarajju viya ducchijjaṃ hoti.
Tesanti tesaṃ moghapurisānaṃ saddhāmandatāya ca paññāmandatāya ca balavaṃ bandhanaṃ nāma, dukkaṭavatthumattakampi mahantaṃ pārājikavatthu viya duppajahaṃ hoti.
Sukkapakkhe pahātabbassāti kiṃ imassa appamattakassa pahātabbassa hetu bhagavatā vattabbaṃ atthi, yassa no bhagavā pahānamāha.
Nanu evaṃ bhagavato adhippāyaṃ ñatvāpi pahātabbamevāti attho.
Paradattavuttāti parehi dinnavuttino, parato laddhena yāpentāti attho.
Migabhūtena cetasā viharantīti apaccāsīsanapakkhe ṭhitā hutvā viharanti.

Migo hi pahāraṃ labhitvā manussāvāsaṃ gantvā bhesajjaṃ vā vaṇatelaṃ vā labhissāmīti ajjhāsayaṃ akatvā pahāraṃ labhitvāva agāmakaṃ araññaṃ pavisitvā pahaṭaṭṭhānaṃ heṭṭhā katvā nipatitvā phāsubhūtakāle uṭṭhāya gacchati.
Tañhi tassāti taṃ varattabandhanaṃ tassa hatthināgassa mahāsarīratāya ceva mahāthāmatāya ca dubbalabandhanaṃ nāma.
Tesaṃ tanti tesaṃ taṃ kulaputtānaṃ saddhāmahantatāya ca paññāmahantatāya ca mahantaṃ pārājikavatthupi dukkaṭavatthumattakaṃ viya suppajahaṃ hoti.
Oluggavilugganti yassa gehayaṭṭhiyo piṭṭhivaṃsato muccitvā maṇḍale laggā, maṇḍalato muccitvā bhūmiyaṃ laggā.
Kākātidāyinti yattha kiñcideva bhuñjissāmāti anto nisinnakāle visuṃ dvārakiccaṃ nāma natthi, tato tato kākā pavisitvā parivārenti.
Sūrakākā hi palāyanakāle ca yathāsammukhaṭṭhāneneva nikkhamitvā palāyanti.
Naparamarūpanti yathā puññavantānaṃ gandhasālibījādi parisuddhaṃ bījaṃ, na evarūpaṃ.
Naparamarūpāti pacchisīsā lambatthanī mahodarā pisācā viya bībhacchā.
So vatassaṃ, yohanti so vatāhaṃ puriso nāma assaṃ, yo kesamassuṃ ohāretvā pabbajeyyanti.
So na sakkuṇeyyāti so evaṃ cintetvāpi gehaṃ gantvā –

“pabbajjā nāma lābhagarukā dukkarā durāsadā, sattapi aṭṭhapi gāme piṇḍāya caritvā yathādhoteneva pattena āgantabbampi hoti, evaṃ yāpetuṃ asakkontassa me puna āgatassa vasanaṭṭhānaṃ icchitabbaṃ, tiṇavallidabbasambhārā nāma dussamodhāniyā, kinti karomī”ti vīmaṃsati.
Athassa taṃ agārakaṃ vejayantapāsādo viya upaṭṭhāti.
“mayi gate imaṃ visaṅkharitvā uddhanālātaṃ karissanti, puna aṭṭanipādavilīvādīni laddhabbāni honti, kinti karissāmī”ti cinteti.
“mayi gate ayaṃ gharaṇī imaṃ dhaññaṃ tena tena saddhiṃ bhuñjissati.
Puna āgatena jīvitavutti nāma laddhabbā hoti, kinti karissāmī”ti cinteti.
Athassa sā aḍḍhateḷasāni koṭṭhāgārasatāni viya upaṭṭhāti.
“mayi gate imaṃ hatthigopako vā assagopako vā yo koci palobhessati, puna āgatena bhattapācikā nāma laddhabbā hoti, kinti karissāmī”ti cinteti.
Athassa sā rūpinī devī viya upaṭṭhāti.
Heṭṭhā “te tañceva pajahanti, te tañceva nappajahantī”ti pajahanakā ca appajahanakā ca rāsivasena dassitā, na pāṭiyekkaṃ vibhattā.

Idāni yathā nāma dabbasambhāratthaṃ gato puriso paṭipāṭiyā rukkhe chinditvā puna nivattitvā vaṅkañca pahāya kamme upanetabbayuttakameva gaṇhāti, evameva appajahanake chaḍḍetvā abbohārike katvā pajahanakapuggalā cattāro hontīti dassetuṃ imaṃ desanaṃ ārabhi.
Ettāvatā “nappajahati, pajahati, khippaṃ pajahatī”ti tayo rāsayo dassitā.
Tesu cattāro janā nappajahanti nāma, cattāro pajahanti nāma, cattāro khippaṃ pajahanti nāma.
Tattha puthujjano sotāpanno sakadāgāmī anāgāmīti ime cattāro janā nappajahanti nāma.
Puthujjanādayo tāva mā pajahantu, anāgāmī kathaṃ na pajahatīti?
Sopi hi yāvadevassa bhavalobho atthi, tāva ahosukhaṃ ahosukhanti abhinandati.
Eteyeva pana cattāro janā pajahanti nāma.
Sotāpannādayo tāva pajahantu, puthujjano kathaṃ pajahatīti?
Āraddhavipassako hi satisammosena sahasā kilese uppanne “mādisassa nāma bhikkhuno kileso uppanno”ti saṃvegaṃ katvā vīriyaṃ paggayha vipassanaṃ vaḍḍhetvā maggena kilese samugghāteti.
Tattha imasmiṃ sutte, mahāhatthipadopame (ma. ni.1.288 ādayo), indriyabhāvaneti (ma. ni.3.453 ādayo) imesu suttesu kiñcāpi tatiyavāro gahito, pañho pana dutiyavāreneva kathitoti veditabbo.
Upadhi dukkhassa mūlanti ettha pañca khandhā upadhi nāma.
Taṃ dukkhassa mūlanti iti viditvā kilesupadhinā nirupadhi hoti, niggahaṇo nitaṇhoti attho.
Evaṃ cattāro puggale vitthāretvā idāni ye pajahanti, te “ime nāma ettake kilese pajahanti”.
Ye nappajahanti, tepi “ime nāma ettake kilese nappajahantī”ti dassetuṃ pañca kho ime udāyi kāmaguṇātiādimāha.
Na bhāyitabbanti etassa sukhassa paṭilābhatopi vipākatopi na bhāyitabbaṃ, bhāvetabbamevetaṃ.
Idaṃ tattha iñjitasminti ye ete aniruddhā vitakkavicārā, idaṃ tattha iñjitaṃ.
Aniñjitasmiṃ vadāmīti idaṃ catutthajjhānaṃ aniñjanaṃ acalanaṃ nipphandananti vadāmi.
Analanti vadāmīti akattabbaālayanti vadāmi, taṇhālayo ettha na uppādetabboti dasseti.
Atha vā analaṃ apariyattaṃ, na ettāvatā alametanti sanniṭṭhānaṃ kātabbanti vadāmi.
Aṇuṃ vā thūlaṃ vāti khuddakaṃ vā mahantaṃ vā appasāvajjaṃ vā mahāsāvajjaṃ vā.
Desanā pana neyyapuggalassa vasena arahattanikūṭeneva niṭṭhāpitāti.
Mahāudāyittheroti kāḷudāyilāḷudāyittherehi añño mahādehatāya mahāudāyīti sāsane paññāto thero.
Yanti bhummatthe paccattavacanaṃ, tena ca anantaraniddiṭṭhasamayo paccāmaṭṭhoti āha “yasmiṃ samaye”ti.
Na bhagavantaṃ paṭiccāti na bhagavantaṃ ārammaṇaṃ katvā.
Bhavatīti bhū, na bhūti abhū, bhayavasena pana sā itthī “abhun”ti āha.
Attā eva putta nāmāsi, sa jīva saradosatan”ti.
Ādīsu putto “attā”ti vuccati kulavasena santāne pavattanato.
Yasmā “bhikkhussa attā mātā”ti vatthukāmā bhayavasena “ātu mātū”ti āha.
Tathā hi naṃ vācakasaddeneva dassento “idhekacce moghapurisā”ti āha.
Āhaṃsūti tesaṃ tathā vacanassa avicchedena pavattidīpananti āha “vadantī”ti.
Hetumhi jotetabbe cetaṃ sāmivacanaṃ yathā “anussavassa hetu, ajjhenassa hetū”ti.
Nanu apassantena viya asuṇantena viya bhavitabbanti?
Satthārā nāma appamattakesu dosesu apassantena viya ca asuṇantena viya ca bhavitabbanti tesaṃ adhippāyena vivaraṇaṃ.
Gale baddhaṃ mahākaṭṭhanti gale olambetvā baddhaṃ rukkhadaṇḍamāha.
Pārājikavatthu viya duppajahaṃ hotīti chandakappahānavasena taṃ pajahituṃ na sakkoti.
Apaccāsīsanapakkheti tāya paradattavuttitāya kassaci paccayassa kutoci apaccāsīsakapakkhe ṭhitā hutvā suppajahaṃ hoti, na tassa pahāne bhāriyaṃ atthi.
Gehayaṭṭhiyoti gehachadanassa ādhārā, tā ujukaṃ tiriyaṃ ṭhapetabbadaṇḍā.
Sā panassa santānānaṃ chinnabhinnatāya oluggaviluggatā, tathā sati sā visamarūpā hotīti āha “oṇatā”tiādi.
So puggalo lūkhabhojī hotīti āha “dhaññaṃ nāma kudrūsako”ti.
So vatāhaṃ pabbajeyyanti sohaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā pabbajeyyaṃ, yohaṃ puriso nāma assaṃ vatāti pabbajjāvasena attano purisaṃ bodheyya.
Taṃsabhāve ṭhitassa bodhā na tu dukkarā, sā khaṭopikā.
Heṭṭhā kiñcāpi appajahanakā paṭhamaṃ dassitā, pajahanakā padhānā, tesañca vasenettha puggalacatukkaṃ dassitaṃ.
Rāsivasenāti “idhudāyi ekacco puggalo”tiādinā catukke āgatavibhāgaṃ anāmasitvā “te te”ti pacuravasena vuttaṃ.
Avibhāgena gahitavatthūsu vibhāgato gahaṇaṃ lokasiddhametanti dassetuṃ “yathā nāmā”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Tassa hi vaseneva te cattāro puggalā jātā.
Aggamaggatthāya vipassanaṃ ussukkāpetvā yāva na taṃ maggena samugghātenti, tāva nappajahanti nāma.
Iti heṭṭhimā tayopi ariyā appahīnassa kilesassa vasena “nappajahantī”ti vuttā, pageva puthujjanā.
Vuttanayena pana vipassanaṃ maggena ghaṭentā te cattāro janā aggamaggakkhaṇe pajahanti nāma.
Te eva tattha sīghakārino khippaṃ pajahanti nāma, tenāha “tatthā”tiādi.

Tattha hi “tassa dhātārammaṇameva cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati adhimuccatī”ti (ma. ni.1.302) ettha atitikkhanātitikkha-nātimandaatimanda-puggalavasena aṭṭhakathāyaṃ (ma. ni. aṭṭha.2.302) tayo vārā uddhaṭā, tattha majjhimavaseneva pañho kathito.
Te ime nāma ettake kilese pajahantīti ye te puthujjanā lābhino ca pañca kāmaguṇe ettake taṃtaṃjhānādivatthuke ca taṃtaṃmaggavajjhatāya paricchinnattā ettake kilese pajahanti.
Gaṇatopi kilesatopi vivittasukhanti gaṇasaṅgaṇikato ca kilesasaṅgaṇikato ca vivittasukhaṃ.
Iñjati tenāti iñjitaṃ, tassa tassa jhānassa khobhakaraṃ oḷārikaṃ jhānaṅgaṃ.
Tathā hi vuttaṃ “ṭhite āneñjappatte”ti (dī. ni.1.244-245; ma. ni.1.384-386; pārā.12-13).
“alameva nibbindituṃ, alaṃ vimuccitun”tiādīsu (dī. ni.2.272; saṃ. ni.2.124,128,134,143), tasmā analaṃ anusaṅgaṃ kātuṃ ayuttanti attho.
Sanniṭṭhānanti sammāpaṭipattiyaṃ alaṃ ettāvatāti ussāhapaṭippassambhanavasena sanniṭṭhānaṃ na kātabbanti yojanā.

Uddhambhāgiyasaññitaṃ aṇuṃ vā orambhāgiyasaññitaṃ thūlaṃ vā, rūparāgoti evarūpaṃ aṇuṃ vā kāmāsavo paṭighanti evarūpaṃ thūlaṃ vā, mudunā pavattiākāravisesena appasāvajjaṃ, kammabandhanaṭṭhena vā appasāvajjaṃ, tabbipariyāyato mahāsāvajjaṃ veditabbaṃ.
Nātitikkhapaññassa vasena desanāya pavattattā “neyyapuggalassa vasenā”ti vuttaṃ.
Sabbaso hi pariyādinnanikantikassa ariyapuggalassa vasena saññāvedayitanirodhassa āgatattā “arahattanikūṭeneva niṭṭhāpitā”ti vuttaṃ.
Yaṃ panettha atthato na vibhattaṃ, taṃ suviññeyyameva.
